data.name: Sabriyah
data.gender_notes: Sabriyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sabriyah is derived from the Arabic word sabr, meaning patience and endurance. It is a virtue that is highly valued in Islamic tradition. The name Sabriyah carries the meaning “Patient and enduring” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Sabriyah usually hope their child will grow to embody patient and enduring and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person with this name is expected to be patient and enduring in the face of challenges and difficulties.
data.etymology: Sabriyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Patient and enduring.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sabriyah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: سبرية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني الصبر والتحمل في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم سبرية مشتق من الجذر العربي 'س-ب-ر' والذي يعني الصبر والتحمل. يستخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية ليدل على الصفات الحميدة مثل الصبر على الشدائد والتحمل في مواجهة التحديات. وردت هذه المعاني في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: 'والصابرين في البأساء والضراء' (البقرة: 177).

in_urdu.name: سبریہ
in_urdu.meaning: نام کا مطلب ہے صبر اور تحمل
in_urdu.long_meaning: سبریہ نام عربی جڑ 'س-ب-ر' سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب ہوتا ہے صبر اور تحمل۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں خوب استعمال ہوتا ہے کیونکہ یہ صبر، مضبوطی، اور چیلنجوں کا सामना کرنے کی صلاحیت کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔ اسلامی روایات میں صبر کی महत्ता کو خاص طور پر ذکر کیا گیا ہے، جیسے قرآن میں: 'وَالصَّابِرِينَ فِي الْبَأْسَاءِ وَالضَّرَاءِ' (البقرة: 177)۔

in_hindi.name: सबरीया
in_hindi.meaning: नाम का अर्थ है धैर्य और सहनशीलता
in_hindi.long_meaning: सबरीया नाम की उत्पत्ति العربية मूल 'س-ب-ر' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है धैर्य और सहनशीलता। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम धार्मिक और सांस्कृतिक महत्व रखता है, क्योंकि यह धैर्य, मजबूती और चुनौतियों का सामना करने की क्षमता को दर्शाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में धैर्य को बहुत महत्व दिया गया है, जैसा कि कुरआन में उल्लेख है: 'والصابرين في البأساء والضراء' (البقرة: 177)।

in_pashto.name: سبريه
in_pashto.meaning: د نوم مطلب د صبر او زغم دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: سبريه نوم د عربيې ريښې 'س-ب-ر' څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د صبر او زغم معنی لري. په افغان او پښتني دود کې، دا نوم د صبر، پيښې، او د ننګونو د منلو څرګندونه کوي. په اسلامي رواياتو کې صبر ته ځانګړی اهميت ورکړل شوی دی، لکه څنګه چې قرآن کې فرمايي: 'والصابرين في البأساء والضراء' (البقرة: 177)۔

in_english.name: Sabriyah
in_english.meaning: Patience, endurance, and perseverance in Arabic origin
in_english.long_meaning: The name Sabriyah derives from the Arabic root 'س-ب-ر' (s-b-r), which means patience, endurance, and perseverance. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes the essential qualities of bearing difficulties and maintaining steadfastness. The Quran highlights the importance of patience in several verses, such as 'And the patient ones in poverty and hardship' (Al-Baqarah: 177). Historically, the name Sabriyah has been used across various Muslim cultures to bestow these virtuous attributes upon the bearer.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sabriyah holds cultural significance as it highlights the importance of patience and endurance as admirable qualities within the Islamic community. It pays homage to a rich history rooted in resilience and fortitude, inspiring those who bear the name to embody these traits in their daily lives.
data.spiritual_significance: On a deeper level, Sabriyah is a powerful reminder of the spiritual value of patience in navigating life's challenges and hardships. It speaks to the belief that inner strength and determination, nurtured through faith, can help us overcome adversity and ultimately lead to personal growth and spiritual transformation. As such, the name Sabriyah holds profound significance not just as a personal identifier but also as a source of inspiration and guidance for those seeking to deepen their connection with the divine.

historical_references.context: Sabriyah bint Abd al-Muttalib was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). She was known for her patience and perseverance. The name Sabriyah means 'patient' in Arabic.
